description: Scala source code implementing a simple KMeans clustering example using Apache Spark, including vector parsing, closest point calculation, iterative clustering, and output of final centers.

classes.name: SparkKMeans
classes.description: Object containing methods for performing KMeans clustering, including vector parsing, closest point determination, and iterative clustering logic.

methods.name: parseVector
methods.description: Parses a line of text into a Breeze DenseVector of Doubles.

methods.name: closestPoint
methods.description: Finds the index of the closest center to a given point.

methods.name: showWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning message about the naive implementation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for running the Spark KMeans clustering example.

methods.name: mergeResults
methods.description: Merges two partial results (vector sum and count) during clustering.
